description: ISO 216 A, B and C sizes, plus the DL envelope, in millimeters. Portrait, so the width is the shorter side. Inches are exact millimeters divided by 25.4. A4 is 210 by 297. Set landscape to swap the sides. Returns JSON with: name, series, number, widthMm, heightMm, areaMm2, widthIn, heightIn. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana).
